description: Ship particulars by IMO number: name, type, flag, MMSI, call sign, year built, gross tonnage, length and beam, current draught and navigation status from VesselFinder's public page, plus deadweight, builder, engine, owner, manager and class society (when listed) from BalticShipping's public vessel register, with that record's last update date. Owner and class data can be years old. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: logistics_imo_vessel_dossier
title: Logistics Imo Vessel Dossier
